status_meaning: every dimension below is derived from measured B-rep geometry and is buildable as-is, but the lug has NOT been cut into the native wing panel in this session -- so the assembly still shows the 30.0 mm gap and no clearance result may claim the hinge is closed
measurement_source: OpenCascade analytic surfaces read from F3R1_V3_DEPLOYED_NOMINAL.step; NOT a mesh estimate

parts.note: double-shear fork straddling the existing spacecraft ear; bore coaxial with Hinge_Pin (r=4.000) at 4.200 -> 0.2 mm running fit
parts.dimension_source: derived from measured ear thickness 10.0 mm and axis offset 30.0 mm

parts.note: one each side of every fork arm; sets 0.5 mm running clearance and prevents axial walk
parts.dimension_source: thickness = the fork/ear side clearance chosen above

parts.note: captures the existing r=4.000 pin axially; groove cut in the pin ends outside the ear stack
parts.dimension_source: standard ring for the measured 8.000 mm pin diameter

parts.note: lands on the EXISTING Hard_Stop block (x -64..-58, z +23..+37) at the 90 deg deployed end stop; defines the deployment angle
receives the deployment torsion-spring leg; spring bodies (r=8.000, bore r=4.200) already exist at x=-93..-75 and -47..-29
parts.dimension_source: sized to the measured spring body envelope

parts.note: routes the panel harness beside the hinge into the EXISTING Harness_Service_Loop (x -110..-90); keeps the service loop off the rotating parts
parts.dimension_source: bend radius from the existing service-loop envelope

load_path: wing panel -> WING_LUG_FORK (double shear) -> Hinge_Pin (r=4.000) -> Hinge_Ear_1/2 -> Root_Base -> Root_Node_Spine -> bus longerons
left_right: mirrored about the XZ plane but assembled independently: each side has its own pin, ears, springs, stop and HDRM, so a single-side deployment failure stays single-sided (this is what makes L_FAIL / R_FAIL physical)

deployment.angle_authority: V2_2 state_policy.json -- unchanged by this definition
deployment.driven_by: existing torsion springs, ends on WING_STOP_PAD
deployment.note: the deploy TRANSIT path remains unauthorised (G2 hold); only the two end states are defined

fits.fork_to_ear_side: 0.5 mm per side, set by the axial spacers

acceptance_tests.criterion: axis offset <= 0.05 mm, axis angle <= 0.1 deg
fork arms overlap the ear over >= 9.0 mm of the 10.0 mm ear thickness
total axial free play <= 0.3 mm with spacers fitted

acceptance_tests.test: stow/deploy driven by the real hinge axis
acceptance_tests.criterion: panel motion is a pure rotation about |y| = 143.15, z = 0, within 0.05 mm
the four donor panels never resolve simultaneously
all eight configurations rebuild after a cold open

acceptance_tests.test: native interference = 0 at both end states
acceptance_tests.criterion: SolidWorks native interference zero, stowed and deployed

what_is_already_real: Hinge_Pin_L/R  -- true cylinder r=4.000 on the measured axis
Torsion_Spring_1/2_L/R -- coaxial bodies r=8.000, bore r=4.200
Root_Base_L/R, Root_Node_Spine_L/R -- load path into the bus
what_is_missing: the wing-side lug/clevis (the whole of the 30.0 mm gap)
axial spacers, pin retainers, stop pad, spring anchor, grommet
native modelling of all of the above into the panel geometry
